keyPoints.en: Honouring neighbours is a sign of faith (al-Bukhari & Muslim); be kind to near and distant neighbours (an-Nisa': 36).
keyPoints.bm: Memuliakan jiran tanda iman (al-Bukhari & Muslim); berbuat baik kepada jiran dekat dan jauh (an-Nisa': 36).

keyPoints.en: Share food, visit when ill, help, avoid noise and harm — Muslim or non-Muslim.
keyPoints.bm: Berkongsi makanan, menziarahi ketika sakit, membantu, elak bising dan menyakiti — Muslim atau bukan Muslim.

keyPoints.en: Give salam and ask permission before entering (an-Nur: 27); up to three times, then return.
keyPoints.bm: Beri salam dan minta izin sebelum masuk (an-Nur: 27); hingga tiga kali, kemudian pulang.

keyPoints.en: Stand beside the door; children ask permission at the three private times (an-Nur: 58).
keyPoints.bm: Berdiri di tepi pintu; anak-anak meminta izin pada tiga waktu aurat (an-Nur: 58).

tip.en: The same respect applies to others' phones, bags and photos.
tip.bm: Penghormatan yang sama terpakai pada telefon, beg dan gambar orang lain.

keyPoints.en: Humans are khalifah (al-Baqarah: 30); do not cause corruption on earth (al-A'raf: 56).
keyPoints.bm: Manusia ialah khalifah (al-Baqarah: 30); jangan membuat kerosakan di bumi (al-A'raf: 56).

keyPoints.en: Corruption on land and sea comes from human actions (ar-Rum: 41); save water, plant trees, recycle.
keyPoints.bm: Kerosakan di darat dan laut berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia (ar-Rum: 41); jimatkan air, tanam pokok, kitar semula.
